value.rationale: Quantifies a natural nonequilibrium observable in the same random-transposition system used as the classical benchmark for permutation-group stochastic physics. An exact nonmonotone variance history contrasts with monotone mean and total-variation equilibration, with strict overshoot for every finite n≥4 and sharp universal 18.488377% limiting peak on the physically distinct early linear-in-deck-size timescale. This reveals a useful failure of stationary fluctuation baselines during randomization; not merely a re-expression of known equilibrium variance.
